propositions: The current severity label (impact-only) does not order consistently with authoritative priority (validity × impact), misleading readers and causing field misreads across runs.
The kernel and findings modules maintain two duplicate severity vocabularies (critical/major/minor/none vs. critical/high/medium/low/info), creating confusion.
The decision replaces severity with numeric priority plus blocking/advisory boolean as the canonical human-readable signal in all gates and output.
The severity field will be removed from the Finding schema entirely (a breaking change documented in release notes), while severity_label() is retained internally for calibration and evaluation.
DET-tier findings (secrets detector, bugfix-size gate) must adopt fixed priority constants since they bypass pass3_decide.
The migration sequence involves four sibling tickets landing priority aggregation, blocking/advisory surface display, fail_on_severity threshold migration, and final severity field removal.
